+def _intervals(data):
+    jobs = data["jobs"]
+    k = data["k"]
+    blocked = set(data.get("blocked", []))
+    mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+    quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+    best_value = None
+    best_ids = None
+    eligible = [job for job in jobs if job["id"] not in blocked]
+    for chosen in _subsets(eligible, k):
+        ids = [job["id"] for job in chosen]
+        idset = set(ids)
+        if not mandatory <= idset:
+            continue
+        counts = {}
+        for job in chosen:
+            counts[job["group"]] = counts.get(job["group"], 0) + 1
+        if any(not low <= counts.get(group, 0) <= high
+               for group, (low, high) in quotas.items()):
+            continue
+        ordered = sorted(chosen, key=lambda job: (job["start"], job["end"]))
+        if any(ordered[i]["start"] < ordered[i - 1]["end"]
+               for i in range(1, len(ordered))):
+            continue
+        value = sum(job["value"] for job in chosen)
+        sorted_ids = sorted(ids)
+        if best_value is None or value > best_value or (value == best_value and sorted_ids < best_ids):
+            best_value, best_ids = value, sorted_ids
+    if best_value is None:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    return {"selected": best_ids, "value": best_value}

+def _subsets(items, size):
+    # Generate fixed-size subsets without relying on order in the input.
+    n = len(items)
+    if size < 0 or size > n:
+        return
+    indices = list(range(size))
+    if size == 0:
+        yield []
+        return
+    while True:
+        yield [items[i] for i in indices]
+        i = size - 1
+        while i >= 0 and indices[i] == n - size + i:
+            i -= 1
+        if i < 0:
+            return
+        indices[i] += 1
+        for j in range(i + 1, size):
+            indices[j] = indices[j - 1] + 1
